defective_pattern: Orchestrator delegates narrative document authoring (.md, .docx) tasks directly to computation-focused subagents like statistics-agent.
why_defective: Statistics agents lack the sophisticated DOM processing, typographic formatting constraints, and linguistic models necessary for academic narrative writing, leading to role boundary bleed and format degradation.
observed_symptoms: Monolithic delegation merging calculation and drafting into single steps
corrective_remedy: Orchestrator must enforce a two-tier decomposition: statistics-agent generates .json metrics; academic-writer drafts .md and .docx using those metrics.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect statistics-agent invoked with request for .docx or .md generation
